projection_height_no_go_reconstruction.setup: For d>=2, k=floor(d/2), work in Q[Z^(d+1)] with variables Y,X_1,...,X_d. Put Phi_i=1-X_i+X_i^2, B=(1+Y)prod_i Phi_i, and Q_A=(1+Y)prod_(i in A)Phi_i for each k-subset A.
projection_height_no_go_reconstruction.divisibility_and_augmentation: B=(prod_(i notin A)Phi_i)Q_A and Q_A(1)=2 because Phi_i(1)=1. The factors 1+Y and Phi_i are irreducible over Q in independent Laurent variables up to monomial units, so the displayed factor count is d+1.
projection_height_no_go_reconstruction.union_support: No monomial collisions occur. A union-support vector has Y digit 0 or 1 and at most k nonzero X digits, each nonzero digit being 1 or 2. Therefore |U|=2 sum_(s=0)^k binom(d,s)2^s.
projection_height_no_go_reconstruction.height_lower_bound: Write ell by integer weights v_0,...,v_d. The ell-values on U lie in an integer interval of length at most |v_0|+2sum_(i>=1)|v_i| <=2||v||_1. Injectivity on |U| points requires interval length at least |U|-1, hence ||v||_1 >=(|U|-1)/2.
projection_height_no_go_reconstruction.exponential_growth: The s=k term gives |U|>=2 binom(d,k)2^k, exponential in d, while the displayed factor count is d+1. The number of divisor rows binom(d,k) is also exponential. Thus neither common separating height nor row count has a polynomial bound from displayed factor count and equal augmentation alone.
projection_height_no_go_reconstruction.upper_existence_guard: Weights 1,3,...,3^(d-1) on X_1,...,X_d and 3^d on Y separate the full digit box, so the construction is consistent with the existential projection theorem.
projection_height_no_go_reconstruction.scope: The obstruction is specifically factor-count-only. It does not refute bounds using support size or coefficient complexity of B, actual mask positivity, common-X scalar-copy geometry, or projection-free multivariate invariants.
